thread.title: Forget China: India Is Apple's Most Disappointing Market

author: admin
title: Forget China: India Is Apple's Most Disappointing Market
text:
Original article
In early January, Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) warned that its revenue would fall 5% year over year during the first quarter of fiscal 2019, compared to a prior forecast for 1% to 5% growth, due to soft sales of iPhones -- particularly in China. The shocking guidance cut sent bulls scrambling, since the Greater China region generated nearly a fifth of Apple's revenue last year.
Investors have paid less attention to India. Apple once considered India to be its next major growth market. After all, the number of smartphone shipments in India surged from 80 million in 2014 to 150 million in 2018, according to Counterpoint Technology Market Research, and rising income levels in the country should have boosted demand for iPhones. Yet demand for Apple's products has hit a brick wall in India, according to Counterpoint. Image source: Apple.
